prompt: In a community solar scheme, where do the solar panels you subscribe to usually stand?

options.text: On your own roof, installed free of charge
On a shared solar farm or large array away from your home, whose power goes into the grid
On the roof of the electricity company’s office
There are no real panels; it is only a billing discount

explanation: Community solar members subscribe to a share of a shared array — typically a solar farm — rather than panels on their own roof. The electricity enters the grid and the member receives a credit on their bill, which is why renters can join.
